test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In which of the following states are Aus, Boro and Aman paddy crops grown in a year?
solution:
The Correct Answer is Odisha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In states like Assam, West Bengal, and** Odisha**, three crops of paddy are grown in a year.
 
• These are **Aus, Aman, and Boro.**
 
• **Two or three crops of rice **are grown in a year in eastern and southern states.
 
• In northern and western parts of the country,
 
 
• where rainfall is high and winter temperature is fairly low,
 
• only one crop of rice is grown during the month from May to November.
 
 
 
• **There are three seasons for growing rice in India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Agriculture of Punjab

 
 
• Overall, two third of the total cropped area of Punjab was used by the three largest crops; wheat, cotton and rice.
 
• Fodder is another large produce of Punjab which derives its importance to fulfill the need to feed the large livestock population of the province.
 
• 10.6% share of the cropped area was claimed by fodder.
 
 
 
• **Agriculture of Haryana**
 
 
• The major Kharif crops are rice, jowar, bajra, maize, cotton, jute, sugarcane, sesame and groundnut, sown in April and May and harvested in November.
 
• The major Rabi crops are wheat, tobacco, gram, linseed, rapeseed and mustard, sown in late October or early November and harvested in March.
 
 
 
• Agriculture of Uttarakhand - 
 
 
• Wheat and rice are the main crops of the State as it covers 30.8 and 23.9 percent of the total cropped area respectively.
 
• Remaining area is covered by Mandua 10.9%, Sugarcane 9.1%, Sawan 5.4%, Maize 2.7%, pulses 2.5%, Oilseed 1.9% and others 12.8%.
